simple.summary: שָׂחָה (sâchâh) means to swim ; causatively, to inundate First listed occurrence: Isa 25 11.

definitions.full: H7811. sachah [ שָׂחָה ] verb swim (Late Hebrew סָחוּ swimming ; Targum סְחָא , Syriac swim, bathe , also שָׂחְיָנָא סַחְיָנָא, סָחְיָא, swimmer ; Aph`el wash ); — Qal Participle + Infinitive construct לִשְׂחוֺת הַשּׂחֶה יְפָרֵשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר Isa 25:11 . Hiph`il Imperfect 1singular אַשְׂחֶה Psa 6:7 I make my bed swim (with my tears; another view below שִׂיחַ Qal 1 ).
